changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: La API usa short_answer_min_ratio como la proporción mínima de criterios de la rúbrica que debe cumplir una respuesta corta para aprobarse (DEF-21: 2 de 3 = 0.667), no como proporción de ítems. El valor por defecto de v2.0.0 (0.200) no coincidía con el de la API. Se corrige el valor por defecto y la descripción, y se actualizan solo las filas que conservan el valor por defecto antiguo.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE learning_paths ALTER COLUMN short_answer_min_ratio SET DEFAULT 0.667
UPDATE learning_paths SET short_answer_min_ratio = 0.667 WHERE short_answer_min_ratio = 0.200
COMMENT ON COLUMN learning_paths.short_answer_min_ratio IS 'Minimum share of rubric criteria a short answer must meet to pass (2 of 3 = 0.667)'

rollback.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN learning_paths.short_answer_min_ratio IS 'Minimum share of short-answer items in assessments (0 to 1)'
ALTER TABLE learning_paths ALTER COLUMN short_answer_min_ratio SET DEFAULT 0.200

changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: level_weights se guarda en porcentaje (80/10/10) y la API los normaliza a fracciones antes de llamar a ai/. Solo se aclara la descripción de la columna.
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN learning_paths.level_weights IS 'Weights of the diagnostic level (test, resume, profile) as percentages, 80/10/10 by default; the API normalizes them to fractions'

rollback.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN learning_paths.level_weights IS 'Weights of the diagnostic level (test, resume, profile), 80/10/10 by default'
